body:
## Change

F1. Remove concealed opponent non-fixed-zone card identity and rotate public instance ID when a position change hides it. Preserve fixed-slot public knowledge. Previously next snapshot failed its concealment invariant.
F2. Regression checks code omission, correlation-ID rotation, and public-event validation.

## Validation

V1. Parent inspected position/visibility handling and existing fail-closed test update, reran 81 projector tests. Worker captured behavioral red/green; boundaries 52 passed. Typecheck, targeted lint/format and diff checks pass.

## Limits

L1. Exact transition tested through production projector messages, not native-engine card scenario. Full repository/browser suites not run locally; CI separate.
title: fix(projection): redact opponent cards when position conceals them
